title: arenaria tenuior
intro: Arenaria tenuior, commonly known as less creeping sandwort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and gastrointestinal issues due to its health benefits. Arenaria tenuior's therapeutic actions are attributed to its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help in soothing muscle cramps and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
